summary: The sermon emphasizes the necessity of developing a receptive heart and mind to hear and obey the Holy Spirit, claiming that true discernment comes from adopting the ‘mind of Christ’ and internalizing Scripture. It argues that the Spirit speaks mainly through our will and our internalized biblical truths, and encourages regular, intentional study of the Bible to sharpen that inner listening and prompting.

interpretation.summary: The sermon emphasizes the necessity of developing a receptive heart and mind to hear and obey the Holy Spirit, claiming that true discernment comes from adopting the ‘mind of Christ’ and internalizing Scripture. It argues that the Spirit speaks mainly through our will and our internalized biblical truths, and encourages regular, intentional study of the Bible to sharpen that inner listening and prompting.
key_points: Develop an ear that can hear the Spirit’s voice, which is identified as speaking through our will and inner desire.
Adopt the mind of Christ so that the inner hearing becomes aligned with God’s will, enabling effective action.
Regularly read, store, and meditate on Scripture so that the Spirit can use these passages to guide and quicken our thoughts in times of need.
biblical_themes: The Holy Spirit as a personal guide and teacher
The importance of an attentive, Spirit‑sensitive listening ear
The role of the Scriptures as the high‑frequency medium of the Spirit’s communication
The transformation of the believer’s mind into the mind of Christ
